title: A renovated Yowie Bay sanctuary where life revolves around the water
excerpt: A waterfront haven with a pool, sauna and boatshed.
content:
House of the Week

A renovated Yowie Bay sanctuary where life revolves around the water

4 Kalang Lane, Yowie Bay

Bed 5 | Bath 4 | Car 2

  • AUCTION: Saturday, November 21 at 9am

Positioned on Yowie Bay, life here revolves around the water, with mornings spent watching the bay come to life, afternoons by the pool and weekends heading straight from home onto the water.

Occupying a street-to-deep water setting on 682 square metres, the property offers a genuine sense of escape while remaining connected to everything that makes Yowie Bay such a sought-after place to live.

"It's not often you find a beautifully renovated family home with such easy access to deep water. The combination of waterfront facilities, entertaining spaces and family functionality makes this property particularly special," listing agent Alex Pitsis from Alex Pitsis Group said.

Character detailing, oak timber floors and abundant natural light bring warmth to the interiors, while multiple living zones create excellent separation for families of all ages.

4 Kalang Lane, Yowie Bay

There are five bedrooms and four bathrooms, including an impressive upper-level parents' retreat.

Venture outdoors to the covered waterfront verandah with an outdoor kitchen featuring stone benchtops, pizza oven, cooktop and dishwasher.

This cascades down to the resort-style pool, elevated sun deck, fire pit area and tropical gardens and out to the private jetty/pontoon, substantial boatshed with internal boat storage and slipway.

To top off this offering there is also a separate landscaped wellness area with a four-person sauna.

"The home delivers an incredible waterfront lifestyle. You can enjoy boating straight from your backyard while remaining close to schools, shops and everything Yowie Bay has to offer," Mr Pitsis said.

  • AGENCY: Alex Pitsis Group
  • CONTACT: Alex Pitsis, 0410 403 704
  • INSPECT: By appointment
